audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart sides in the content layer and the full-layer phases contradict their own 'why' text and the packet levelChart. whys[0] says Mini's ranged autos win level 1, but win[0] says Mordekaiser; whys[5] calls level-6/first-item a coin-flip, but win[5] says Gnar.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is [Gnar, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Gnar, Mordekaiser, Skill, Gnar] and matches the prose exactly. The stored sides are shifted.
audit.corrected: Whole chart flipped as one atomic group in both layers, with ratings realigned (Gnar rows 6-7/10, Mordekaiser rows 3-4/10, Skill row 5/10).

audit.whatIsWrong: Power spikes were written around a generic 'Stridebreaker timing' template and never state Realm of Death's real cooldown.
audit.why: Kit file: Realm of Death is 140/120/100s. That number is what makes 'wait it out' actionable — a missed R at rank 1 is over two minutes of free lane.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] now carries the 140s figure; phases[4] states the siphon and the reason Mini form loses it.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive kit interactions were never named: Death's Grasp (E, 700 range, 16s at rank 1) pulls you into a single-target Obliterate (Q, 8s at rank 1) which deals bonus damage when it hits you alone, while Indestructible (W) banks the damage he takes from your poke and converts it into a shield or heal.
audit.why: Riot's own text states Obliterate's damage is increased against a single target and that Indestructible stores damage dealt AND taken. Poking a Mordekaiser who is otherwise unharassed literally feeds his shield.
audit.corrected: Stated across phases[1], phases[2] and dosFull[1].d, with Grievous Wounds tied to the Indestructible heal.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1] is titled 'Build MR' but its description was a copy-paste of the trading line and said nothing about MR or anti-heal.
audit.why: The missing-interactions file flags Grievous Wounds timing as the deciding factor in extended trades.
audit.corrected: Description rewritten to name MR items and the anti-heal purchase.

edits.before: Boomerang + hop kite wins every melee matchup early. Identify how Mordekaiser contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Mini's ranged autos plus one Boomerang win level 1 — Mordekaiser has no dash, so chip him and step outside his 675-range Obliterate.

edits.before: Rage management is the champion — track your own bar. Only take the trade when Mordekaiser's Realm of Death is down.
edits.after: Indestructible banks your poke into a shield and heal, so his return trade is free — stop stepping into Death's Grasp range.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Mordekaiser must walk into your range.
edits.after: At 3 his Death's Grasp pull into a single-target Obliterate, shielded by Indestructible, beats a Mini Gnar who overstays.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Realm of Death's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Rage banked, this is your window: Mega Wallop stuns through Indestructible and a wall-pinned GNAR! flattens a dash-less Mordekaiser.

edits.before: Mega + R against a wall is the best engage top lane owns. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Mordekaiser's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Realm of Death is a 140-second 1v1 that siphons your stats — caught in Mini with no wall and no Mega bulk, you lose that duel.

edits.before: Stridebreaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Realm of Death's cooldown.
edits.after: Pure form RNG: Mega-up you wall-combo him, Mega-down he ults you — it is a coin-flip on your Rage bar.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Mordekaiser carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Your wall-ult and Hyper kiting peel him off the carry, wasting a single-target R that must be spent on you, not them.

edits.before: Boomerang Mordekaiser's last-hits, AA-hop out of his reach, and time Mega so the transform lands ON his engage window.
edits.after: Mercury's Treads and Spectre's Cowl blunt his aura and R, and Executioner's cuts the Indestructible heal that wins long trades.

edits.before: Realm of Death is the danger window: if he ults you in Mini form he drags you into the death realm 1v1, siphons your stats, and you have no Mega bulk or wall to break it.
edits.after: Realm of Death is the danger window: 140s at rank 1, and if it catches you in Mini he drags you into a 1v1 that siphons your stats with no wall or Mega bulk to answer.

notes: The kit file tags grounding on Mordekaiser's Obliterate (Q); Riot's own Q text says nothing about grounding, so I did not assert any dash-denial interaction against Gnar's Hop (E) anywhere. Left unverified. Level-chart flips are proposed as one group per the atomic rule; win[3] and win[6] already read Gnar and were left alone, and win[4] / phases[4].rating are included as no-op anchors only where the group needed them.
